data.body: Fixed: corrected misleading comment on line 716 of test_explicit_soft_cap_argument_takes_precedence_over_module_constant. Old comment said 'triggers nudge at aug_turn=soft_cap=1' implying calls 1-2 cause the nudge; corrected to clarify call 1 is the initial call (before aug loop), call 2 is aug_turn=0 normal turn, and the nudge actually fires at aug_turn=1 (call 3).
